page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords with Latin glosses and references. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword alone at the lower right.

main_text.p: Efr.4.15. עָבְדָא קְרֵב fœmin. Faciebat, id eft, gerebat bellum, Dan.7.21. Infinit. לְמֶעְבַּד Facere, Efræ4.22. Futur. דִּי תַעְבְּדוּן Quod facturi eftis, Efr.6.8. Niph. Præter, vel Partic. מִלְךְ לִשְׂדֵה נַעֲבַד Regi de agro fervitur, Eccl.5.8. Ex terra enim victum suum habet, scribit Aben Efra; נֶעְבְּדְתֶּם Ut colamini, Ezech.39.9. Futurum, לָא יַעְבַּד כֵּן In quo nihil colitur, Deut.21.4. תַּעְבַּד Colatur, Ezech.36.34. Pyh.Præter. לָא עָבַד בַּה Qua non fit fervitum, quæ ad fervitia nondū fit adhibita, Deut.21.3. עָבֵד בָּךְ Servitum fuit in te, Servitus exercita fuit in te, Jefa.14.3. Hiph. Servire fecit, vel coëgit, Servitutem exegit, Servitute prefsit. Præter. הַעְבִּיד אֲרֵי־חַיָּלוּ [?] Servire fecit copias ejus, Ezech.29.18. Chald. ex Ithpehal Partic. מִתְעֲבַד בַּה Fit in ea, Efr.4.19. Fœm. אִסְפַּרְנָא מִתְעֲבְדָא [?] Celeriter fit, Efræ5.8. Futur. נוּלֵי יִתְעֲבַד Sterquilinium fiat, Efr.6.11. הָדְמִין תִּתְעֲבִדוּן Frusta efficiemini, Dan.2.5.

עָבַד m. Servus, Genef.9.25. Aff. וְעַבְדּוֹ Et servum ejus, Exod.20.27. עַבְדְּכֶם Servum vestrum, Genef.18.5. Plural. עֲבָדִים Servi, Genef.9.25. Constr. עַבְדֵי Jefa.54.17. Aff. עֲבָדָיו Servos suos, Gen.20.8. עַבְדֵיהֶם Servos eorū, Efr.2.65. Et ex fignificatione Chaldaica, וַעֲבִדֵיהֶם Et facta, opera eorum, Eccl.9.1. Chald. עֲבַד Serve Dei viventis, Dan.6.25. לַעֲבָדֶיךָ Servis tuis, Dan.2.4. לַעֲבָדוּהִי Servos suos, Dan.3.28.

עֲבֹדָה f. Servitus, Minifterium, Opus, Cultus, Cultura: עֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה Servitutem duram, Exod.1.14. Constr. וַעֲבֹדַת הַצְּדָקָה Et opus justitiæ, Jefa.23. v.17. Aff. עֲבֹדָתוֹ Minifterium ejus, Exod.35.21.
עֲבִידָא, fœm. Chald. Opus, Efr.5.8. Constr. עֲבִידַת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא Opus domus Dei, Efr.4.24.

page.notes: Printed text is set in Latin roman with Hebrew and some Greek-free entries; Hebrew vowel pointing and some letters are read with uncertainty and are marked [?] where doubtful. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Catchword at lower right taken as the next headword, uncertain. No marginal notes on this page.
